Subject: Intro: DataForge listing + co-sell for GCP marketplace

Hi Ben —

Great to meet you at Anthology last week. DataForge is ready to begin the intake for a GCP marketplace listing and co-sell certification. Our VP of Alliances asked me to kick off evidence gathering and get the technical intake scheduled. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm Redwood's listing SKUs and pricing model for a GCP SKU mapping (we'll need a CSV we can ingest).
- Provide any security/compliance artifacts you require on our side to finish the marketplace questionnaire.
- Identify the co-sell enablement owner and a technical contact who can do a short architecture review.

We can be flexible on timing but would like to get this into the April sprint. If helpful, I attached our initial architecture and a draft SKU map (placeholder) in this thread.

Attachments: [Attachment: df-architecture-diagram-v2.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: dataforge-pricing-sku-map.csv (CSV)]

Thanks Aisha — great to meet you as well. Moving this into my partner intake queue. Quick notes and asks so we have a clear path to publish and co-sell: 

1) Evidence checklist we need from DataForge (we can share a formal doc but to start):
   - SOC2 type II summary + date of last audit
   - Data processing addendum (DPA) or pointer to where the DPA lives
   - Customer-facing product architecture (you've attached a draft — thanks)
   - Confirm where customer billing will originate (GCP marketplace vs direct invoicing)

2) SKU/pricing mapping: please send your canonical CSV (we need: sku_id, sku_description, unit_type, list_price_usd, commitment_terms). We attached a template in the past; I'll resend.

3) Technical review: looping in Karthik for integration and Olga for listing evidence. Vivek — add for co-sell ops and cert timeline planning.

Proposed cadence: share all evidence by EOD Thu (4/5), technical review the following week, publish target: mid-April if everything looks good. If that timeline won't work, tell us what your target is.

I will also create a shared Drive folder (link below) and a HubSpot record for tracking.

Thanks — reviewed the attachments. Quick internal notes and open questions (cc'd partner for visibility):

- Architecture: the diagram looks good at a high level. Need a short one-page explanation of where customer data is persisted and retention defaults (helpful for listing copy).
- Compliance: summary of SOC2 is fine. We will still need a CSV of evidence items for the marketplace intake form (this is not the full report).
- Billing: if DataForge prefers marketplace billing, we need confirmation on revenue split mechanics and whether DataForge is comfortable with GCP's 30/60 day settlement cadence.

Action items for DataForge:
- Send a 1-paragraph description of data persistence & retention policy (bullet list is fine).
- Confirm marketplace billing preference and proposed revenue share model.
- If possible, provide a contact for your legal/compliance team for DPA exchanges.

Internal action items: 
- Karthik: please review the integration notes below and confirm any additional listing capabilities we'll need (e.g., required IAM scopes for billing, sample provisioning API endpoints).
- Vivek: draft co-sell enablement checklist and timeline for certification (can you slot a pre-read by 4/6?).

Quick technical notes from my end after reviewing the diagram and CSV: 

- Provisioning: we will need an API endpoint that can accept a tenant_id and return a provisioning status (200 + JSON payload). Please include example request/response.
- IAM scopes: marketplace integration will require a service account with the following minimal scopes: compute.read, storage.read_write. If DataForge uses customer-supplied credentials for provisioning, we need explicit docs for the roll-forward flow.
- Latency/seq: do you have typical tokenization/seq-length expectations? Many customers use Redwood in the 1k-2k token window; if DataForge's pipelines expect longer contexts we should confirm memory/kv-cache needs.

Attachments referenced below: [Attachment: sample-provisioning-api-spec.txt] (partner to provide)

Next steps: Aisha — can you share the example API payload and a contact for an engineer who can meet with Karthik for 30 minutes next week?

Thanks,
Karthik
